notes: Independent review REV-PAPER-BEUZARTPLESSIS-LIU-ZHANG-ETAL-21 by Claude Code, session cc-2aeb03; the extraction was written by Claude Code (cc-39fac3, #2043). arXiv:1912.07169v3, the authors' final version the extraction read (PDF and TeX source, both hashes matching), was read in full on page images in six ranges against every item, with the TeX source for formulas. Corrected in place: 98 item fields (41 statements, 36 locators, 17 names, 4 kinds) and 3 notes; 20 bundled items split, one numbered result per item, as the protocol requires; 65 items added (1 planned) for the split-off results, definitions, constructions and cited inputs; no item removed. The briefs of all three routes carry the confirmed corrections. Prerequisites: the 25 cited works, checked against Crossref, plus Jacquet–Shalika (1981), used for Theorem 1.3. Mistakes: E1–E9 confirmed, E1 and E4 revised as the independent checks upheld. 40 new claims were checked a second time, independently: 39 confirmed, 1 rejected; one duplicate was folded, and the rest are E10–E47. The main new ones: Proposition 4.7 is applied to archimedean test functions in the completed Schwartz space, which Chaudouard–Zydor do not cover and the paper's density argument does not give, and Theorems 1.8–1.10 and 4.14 rest on it (E39); Theorem 4.14(4) is false as printed for non-automorphic π (E45); Remark 2.16's description of the infinitesimal characters and of the kernel fails for SU(2), and the 'only if' half of its conjecture for SU(3) (E19); the set of involutions of a root datum need not be finite, so Lemma 2.10 needs θ finite (E16); an error in the proof of Proposition 3.17 for M = G (E36); gaps in the proofs of Lemmas 2.18, 3.12, 3.13 and Proposition 4.13 (E21, E34, E35, E43). Theorems 1.1, 1.3 and 1.4 stand.
